scope: Diagnostic-only RAM store buffering; notebook and isolated nanovax A53 microbenchmarks plus local loopback training. No new physical modem call or remote working-checkout changes.
method: Four paired repetitions reverse reference/candidate order on alternate pairs. Fixed guest instruction budget, process CPU time. Ordinary-store checks use six pairs. A53 pinned to CPU 3. No temperature or frequency samples.
training_limit: One sequential reference/candidate pair with native exit counters; both CONNECT and transfer exact data. Different guest work and DSP training paths, so timings are observations, not a fixed-work speedup measurement. Earlier overlapping regression/training sample is excluded from this comparison.
